note: What every fake daemon answers: node/test/fake-daemon.js, python/tests/fake_daemon.py, and testdata/fake-daemon/main.go, which both suites run on Windows. A request asks for a scenario by its URL's host; a control line is answered as TLSFORGE_TEST_PROTOCOL says; and a fake started with --proxy-stdin reads its init line first, and answers it as TLSFORGE_TEST_INIT says. Each fake answers the control line "scenarios" with the names it has, read from the table it dispatches on, and each suite holds its fake to this file: a scenario added to one fake and not the others fails there. A host no fake knows is answered with an error naming it.

requests.ok: 200, its body saying what reached the fake
requests.error: the request failed: an error and an id, no other field
requests.null-fields: a failure as the daemon sends one: status 0, url and body empty, headers and cookies null
requests.null-values: every field null but the id
requests.binary: a body that is not UTF-8, in base64
requests.echo-body: the request's body and bodyEncoding, handed back
requests.bad-base64: bodyEncoding base64, and a body that is not
requests.bad-header-list: a header a list of numbers
requests.legacy-headers: a header a string, as protocol 1 sent them
requests.newer-fields: the answer, with a field a daemon newer than the packages might add
requests.garbage: a line that is not JSON
requests.no-id: an answer without an id, then the answer
requests.wrong-id: an answer to another id, then the answer
requests.trailing-lines: the answer, then a line that is not JSON and one without an id
requests.answer-then-exit: the answer, then exits with code 4
requests.stubborn: no answer, and reads nothing more for 30 s
requests.deaf: the answer, then reads nothing more for 30 s
requests.stderr: a line on stderr, then the answer
requests.stderr-chunks: one line on stderr in two writes and a second line, then the answer

protocols: hello is answered with protocol 2, and TLSFORGE_TEST_CAPABILITIES as capabilities
protocols.1: as a daemon older than control lines: bad request: no url
protocols.newer: protocol 7, which a daemon newer than the packages speaks, with browser_context and a capability nobody knows yet

inits: the init line answered without an error, and requests from then on
inits.deaf: closes its input before it reads the init line, and stays for 30 s
inits.garbage: a line that is not JSON
inits.refuse: an error naming the proxy without its password, then exits with code 1
